narrative.overview: A single calm column of text on near-white paper. The page is mostly whitespace. Hierarchy comes from size, weight, and two greys rather than color or ornament, and the one violet accent appears only when something responds to the reader. Nothing floats, glows, or animates. Depth is a hairline. The interface steps back so the writing and the person behind it carry the page.
keyCharacteristics: One typeface (Inter), set large and tight for headings and airy for reading.
Warm near-white ground with cool grey ink. Dark mode mirrors every role.
Content sits in a single centered column. There are no cards, grids of tiles, or sidebars.
Hairline rules (1px `line`) separate sections and list rows.
The accent is a state, not a fill.

rules.name: The Violet-as-State Rule
rules.body: `accent` appears only in response to the reader (hover, focus, selection) or as a hairline (the blockquote rule). It is never a background fill or a resting text color.

rules.name: The Display-Only Grey Rule
rules.body: `headline` grey sits at about 3.4:1 on light Paper, so it is reserved for display-size type. Never use it for text below 24px.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Inter only, at weights 400, 500, 550, and 600. Hierarchy comes from size, weight, and grey value, never from a second face.

rules.name: The Single Column Rule
rules.body: Content lives in one centered column. There are no sidebars, multi-column feeds, or full-bleed bands.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separate with a 1px `line` rule or with space. Never with a shadow, a card, or a tinted panel.

dos: Do keep every new surface inside the 744px column (660px for long-form reading) with the incumbent gutters.
Do define any new color as a CSS variable in `globals.css` with both light and dark values, then map it in `tailwind.config.ts`.
Do separate content with 1px `line` hairlines and whitespace.
Do keep the skip link, `:focus-visible` outline (2px accent, 6px offset, `focus` radius), and `prefers-reduced-motion` handling intact.
donts: Don't add shadows, cards, tinted panels, or gradients. The system is flat.
Don't use `accent` as a fill or as resting text color.
Don't use `headline` grey below display sizes.
